title: WOW! Children's Museum

services.name: Basic Field Trips
services.desc: Support the Museum by purchasing an annual family membership. Memberships include unlimited admission for a year and other great benefits! Do you have questions about field trips? Contact Claire Douglas, Education Programs Coordinator PLEASE NOTE: We are unable to accommodate Field Trips and large groups during Thanksgiving week, BVSD Winter Break, or BVSD Spring Break. WOW! Field Trips give local school children an opportunity to learn through play and explore the world around them in a fun, unique, and educational environment. Field trips include two hours of self guided explorations of the Museum. During a field trip, children can delve into hands-on exhibits about a variety of subjects,
